name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph_v2
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph with prioritized Town Shop Arbitrage extended to Day 30, Proactive Peak Monetization, bounded land expansion, cluster harvesting, and strict agronomic maturation horizons.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade, respecting zero-livestock feed corrections.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums, extended through Day 30 for terminal harvest cycles.

nodes.name: Proactive Peak Monetization
nodes.description: Actively monetizes non-contract surplus inventory when spot prices reach cyclical peaks to maximize profit margins before market corrections.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief & Terminal Liquidation
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors, and executes full terminal liquidation of all shed inventory on Day 30.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into rapid workforce acceleration (10-hand rush by Day 4), bounded contiguous land expansion (16-18 plots), and commercial seeds strictly gated by agronomic maturation horizons.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: cluster harvesting, urgent watering, worker drop-offs, livestock feeding, planting, and ground maintenance. Enforces terminal Day 30 harvest-only sunset.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(4, n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 180.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) when surplus cash covers seed costs and wage buffers.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if shed capacity exceeds 88%; never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows.

attributes.guidance: Execute proactive batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus inventory when spot prices hit 1.10x-1.25x base price peaks, utilizing available market order slots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell inventory committed to active town shop contracts. Ensure market orders leave sufficient engine cap slots for critical farm execution.

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.70 * base_price; only relax floor to 0.45 * base_price if shed_used >= 95. On Day 30 after hour 18, execute full terminal liquidation of all shed inventory regardless of price floors.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.50 base price during transient shed spikes (except Day 30 terminal liquidation); never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (max(4, n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0); never evict produce allocated for active town shop fulfillment.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * (1.15 if day <= 4 else 1.35) and (hired_hands < 10 or (total_plots < 18 and uncultivated_plots <= 1) or has_fertilizer_deficit or unplanted_plots > 0) and day <= 29
attributes.guidance: Sprint to 10 hands by Day 4 using a lean 1.15x wage reserve. Expand contiguous land up to 16-18 plots when uncultivated plots <= 1. Procure seeds respecting maturation horizons: halt Pumpkins after Day 23, Tomatoes after Day 25, Carrots after Day 27. On Days 28-29, only procure Wheat.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allocate reinvestment capital if net cash after purchase drops below the dynamic wage buffer; do not acquire land plots that hands cannot consistently water; halt land and hand expansion strictly after Day 26.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch up to (10 - active_market_orders) hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Cluster harvest adjacent ripe plots until full carry capacity; 2) Urgent watering to prevent growth stalls; 3) Drop off carried items at shed; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Plant commercial seeds; 6) Weed clearing and ground tilling. On Day 30, halt all planting/tilling/weeding to commit 100% capacity to harvesting and terminal shed drop-offs by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never prioritize weeding over harvesting or watering; do not leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain; never exceed the 10-order global engine cap.
